pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts"
try
delete (first person whose name is "John Doe")
save
return true
on error
return false
end try
end tell' && osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts" to quit' && sleep 2
instruction: Create a new contact for a business colleague named 'John Doe', including his phone number '555-1234', email 'john.doe@example.com', and company 'Example Corp'.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts"
set foundContact to (first person whose name is "John Doe")
set contactCompany to organization of foundContact
set phoneValue to value of phone 1 of foundContact
set emailValue to value of email 1 of foundContact
if contactCompany is "Example Corp" and phoneValue is "555-1234" and emailValue is "john.doe@example.com" then
return true
else
return false
end if
end tell'
